The '''900 gene-lock''' was a device manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Once loaded with the owner's [[DNA/Legends|DNA]], it locked down the weapon if the user's genetic profile did not match.<ref name="DC" />
